bosses.name: Zul'jan
bosses.note: Stage One and Stage Three boss; 257911 is the raid combat unit that casts in logs (wowhead's 267797/259447 are questline versions).

spells.name: Fangs of the Coiled Altar
spells.note: Cast ID for the poison self-infusion; journal name is 'Fangs of the Crucible'.

spells.name: Fangs of the Coiled Altar
spells.note: Unavoidable raid-wide Nature pulse every 1s for 8s — healing pressure, not positioning.

spells.name: Twinfang Toxin
spells.note: Nature DoT applied to the primary target by autoattacks that consume Fangs stacks.

spells.name: Noxious Ground
spells.note: Persistent poison pool ticking Nature damage every 1s; wowhead confirms a ground area effect.

spells.name: Toxic Deluge
spells.note: Cast/phase marker for the venom wave; not seen as a cast event in the PTR sample.

spells.name: Toxic Deluge
spells.note: Missile impact — Nature damage within 4 yards of each landing venom chunk.

spells.name: Venom Rupture
spells.note: Fires when a Coalesced Venom orb is destroyed (Guillotine axe impact or Sever) — raid-wide Nature hit plus a stacking 10s DoT, and the single largest killer at 58 Mythic killing blows.

spells.name: Volatile Venom
spells.note: Debuff from touching floor venom that spawns a fresh Coalesced Venom orb when it expires; wowhead confirms no dispel type.

spells.name: Volatile Venom
spells.note: Pulse damage every 1s to players within 5 yards of the carrier for 5s.

spells.name: Tainted Blood
spells.note: Mythic-only 10s vulnerability marker (wowhead lists +200% absorb taken); journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Sever
spells.note: Frontal Physical cleave that also destroys Coalesced Venom in its path; journal lists 1299680 but 1299684 fires in logs.

spells.name: Sever
spells.note: Stacking +200% Sever damage taken for 30s — the tank-swap trigger.

spells.name: Venomfang
spells.note: Cast marker for the poison axe that bounces between several players.

spells.name: Venomfang
spells.note: GENUINE POISON DISPEL — wowhead confirms dispel type Poison, 14s Nature DoT, and logs show 58 healer dispels (Nature's Cure / Naturalize).

spells.name: Venomfang
spells.note: Secondary Venomfang ID, same mechanic — wowhead confirms dispel type Poison, 6s duration.

spells.name: Axegrinder
spells.note: Cast marker for spinning axes that ricochet around the arena; journal says Mythic-only but logs show it on all difficulties.

spells.name: Axegrinder
spells.note: Armour-ignoring Physical damage to anyone a wandering axe touches; on Mythic the axes never despawn.

spells.name: Guillotine
spells.note: Cast ID for the thrown axe; journal-only, unseen in the PTR sample.

spells.name: Guillotine
spells.note: Target marker on the axe recipient.

spells.name: Guillotine
spells.note: Split soak damage — being hit is the job, so report head count per cast and never per-player failures.

spells.name: Guillotined
spells.note: Soak vulnerability (+500% Guillotine damage taken, permanent on Mythic) — the soak-rotation ledger.

spells.name: Guillotined
spells.note: Journal's Mythic Guillotined variant; logs show 1307425 firing on Mythic instead.

spells.name: Execution
spells.note: Undersoak punishment when fewer than 5 players are inside the Guillotine radius — 16 Mythic killing blows.

spells.name: Widow's Kiss
spells.note: Guillotine near-band punishment — Nature damage to players within 40 yards of the axe.

spells.name: Widow's Touch
spells.note: Guillotine far-band punishment — Nature damage to players at least 40 yards from the axe.

spells.name: Defilement of the Coiled Altar
spells.note: Stage Three cast ID — the Shadow mirror of Fangs; journal name is 'Defilement of the Crucible'.

spells.name: Defilement of the Coiled Altar
spells.note: Raid-wide healing-absorption debuff; 1193 applications on the Normal PTR report.

spells.name: Corrupted Toxin
spells.note: Stage Three stacking Shadow tank DoT applied by autoattacks — the Stage Three swap trigger.

spells.name: Defiled Ground
spells.note: Stage Three ground hazard applying healing absorption every 1s while stood in it.

spells.name: Grim Guillotine
spells.note: Stage Three Guillotine — same 9-yard split soak plus healing absorption; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Grim Execution
spells.note: Stage Three undersoak punishment; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Death's Embrace
spells.note: Stage Three near-band range punishment; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Death's Whisper
spells.note: Stage Three far-band range punishment; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Guillotined
spells.note: Heroic Grim Guillotine vulnerability stack; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Guillotined
spells.note: Mythic Grim Guillotine vulnerability stack, permanent; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Blighted Sever
spells.note: Stage Three frontal cone applying Gravebound and clearing venom and Manifestations; journal lists 1307279 but 1307292 fires in logs.

spells.name: Blighted Sever
spells.note: Blighted Sever vulnerability debuff — the Stage Three cone swap trigger.

bosses.name: Hex Lord Malacrass
bosses.note: Stage Two, Intermission and Stage Three boss entity; confirmed caster in the PTR logs and soulbound to Zul'jan in Stage Three.

spells.name: Dread Bolt
spells.note: Filler Shadow nuke on the primary target — wowhead flags it 'AI Primary Ranged Attack', so any non-tank hit is a threat failure.

spells.name: Dreadful Presence
spells.note: Aura ID for the passive raid pulse; journal-only, unseen as a cast in logs.

spells.name: Dreadful Presence
spells.note: Unavoidable ramping Shadow damage every 2s while Malacrass is active — pure healing pressure.

spells.name: Dreadmarch
spells.note: Possession cast that warcraft.wiki flags INTERRUPTIBLE, but zero interrupt events appear in the PTR sample — confirm kickability before trusting a missed-kick table.

spells.name: Dreadmarch
spells.note: Absorb-and-pacify subjugation debuff (wowhead: not dispellable); breaking it frees the player and spawns 2 Manifestations of Dread.

spells.name: Falling
spells.note: Environmental fall death — cross-reference every occurrence with a 1297445 application in the preceding 20s.

spells.name: Soul Sever
spells.note: Frontal Shadow cone applying Gravebound and destroying Manifestations of Dread caught in it.

spells.name: Soul Sever
spells.note: Soul Sever vulnerability debuff — the Stage Two cone swap trigger.

spells.name: Gravebound
spells.note: Soul-fragmentation marker starting the 16s collection timer (wowhead: no dispel type) — the trigger, not the failure.

spells.name: Gravebound
spells.note: Gravebound expiry kill — the player failed to collect their Soul Fragments in 16s.

spells.name: Gravebound
spells.note: Secondary Gravebound damage ID.

spells.name: Eternal Nightfall
spells.note: KICK TARGET — lethal raid-wide cast, kickable only once Veil of Twilight is destroyed; 13 interrupt events confirm it in logs.

spells.name: Veil of Twilight
spells.note: Absorb shield that gates the Eternal Nightfall kick — time-to-break is the metric that matters.

spells.name: Suffocating Darkness
spells.note: Stacking healing absorption while the Veil holds (wowhead: not dispellable) — peak stacks proxy veil break speed.

spells.name: Spiritcackle
spells.note: Summons a Spiteful Soulcoiler; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Gloombomb
spells.note: Cast marker for the bomb mark; warcraft.wiki attributes Gloombomb to Spiteful Soulcoiler, but logs record Malacrass as the caster.

spells.name: Gloombomb
spells.note: 5s bomb mark on the carrier (wowhead shows a size-modifier marker, no damage component under this ID) — the detonation damage ID is not yet identified, so this cannot drive a spread-failure count.

spells.name: Gloombomb
spells.note: Journal's Heroic+ Gloombomb variant; unseen in logs.

spells.name: Soulbinding
spells.note: Intermission ritual binding Malacrass to Zul'jan's corpse — a DPS race, not a kick; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Ghastly Regeneration
spells.note: Heals 2% max HP every 1s for 35s while raising damage taken by 100%; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Deathguard
spells.note: Malacrass absorbs stunned Manifestations and takes 99% reduced damage — damage logged here is wasted throughput.

spells.name: Soulbound
spells.note: Stage Three link — killing one boss berserks the other for +500% damage and attack speed every 5s; journal-only, unseen in logs.

adds.name: Coalesced Venom Stalker
adds.note: The venom orb seeded by Toxic Deluge and by expiring Volatile Venom; destroying it triggers Venom Rupture, so placement is the whole game.

spells.name: Coalesced Venom
spells.note: The orb's aura, pulsing raid-wide Nature damage every 2s until destroyed — orbs alive over time is the core management metric.

spells.name: Coalesced Venom
spells.note: Pulse damage — deaths here mean too many orbs were left alive at once.

adds.name: Manifestation of Dread
adds.note: Spawned in pairs when a Dreadmarch shield breaks; immune to damage and cleared only by Soul Sever / Blighted Sever or by being stunned into Deathguard.

spells.name: Manifestation of Dread
spells.note: Spawn marker.

spells.name: Unassailable
spells.note: Full damage immunity — any damage logged into this target is wasted throughput.

spells.name: Unnerving Fixation
spells.note: Fixate — the Manifestation only moves while its target is not looking at it.

spells.name: Despair
spells.note: Fires when a Manifestation reaches its fixated target — heavy Shadow damage plus a knockback that can throw the player off the platform.

spells.name: Malevolent Resonance
spells.note: Mythic-only detonation when two Manifestations touch; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Spiritveil
spells.note: Mythic-only invisibility to everyone but the fixate target; journal-only, unseen in logs.

adds.name: Spiteful Soulcoiler
adds.note: NPC ID NEEDED — look up via WCL. Summoned by Spiritcackle on Heroic+; not reached in the PTR log sample.

spells.name: Wail of Terror
spells.note: KICK TARGET — 7s cast fearing the entire raid for 5s; warcraft.wiki and the journal both flag it interruptible, but no log evidence yet.

spells.name: Retaliatory Malice
spells.note: Passive Shadow damage to random players every 3s while the add lives; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Spirit Shield
spells.note: Mythic-only 99% damage reduction, stripped only by Gloombomb detonations; journal-only, unseen in logs.

adds.name: Virulent Cyst
adds.note: NPC ID NEEDED — look up via WCL. Mythic-only add that one Toxic Deluge orb mutates into; unseen in the PTR log sample.

spells.name: Caustic Secretion
spells.note: Mythic-only ground damage; journal-only, unseen in logs.

adds.name: Virulent Mutation
adds.note: NPC ID NEEDED — look up via WCL. Mythic-only add that some Toxic Deluge orbs warp into; its Mutagenic Venom IDs are confirmed in the Mythic logs.

spells.name: Virulent Mutation
spells.note: Mythic-only mutation marker on the add; journal-only, unseen in logs.

spells.name: Mutagenic Venom
spells.note: Mythic-only carrier marker (wowhead: no dispel type); absent from Heroic and Normal, matching the journal's Mythic-only flag.

spells.name: Mutagenic Venom
spells.note: Mythic-only Plague pulse every 1s within 8 yards for 5s — anyone other than the carrier taking it failed to spread.

adds.name: Fragment of Malacrass
adds.note: NPC ID NEEDED — look up via WCL. Soul fragments that rupture from Malacrass during the Soulbinding intermission and crawl toward Zul'jan.

spells.name: Spirit Erasure
spells.note: Raid-wide Shadow damage when a player steps on a fragment — destroying fragments is the assigned job, so report simultaneous occurrences, never per-player failures.

spells.name: Reclaim Essence
spells.note: A fragment that reaches Zul'jan heals him 1% max HP; journal-only, unseen in logs.

adds.name: Soul Fragment
adds.note: NPC ID NEEDED — look up via WCL. Pickups scattered by Gravebound that the debuffed player must collect within 16s; no abilities of their own.
